Definition: properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be in pain, be sore, have pain, be sorrowful; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be in pain (physical); 1a2) to be in pain (mental); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause pain, hurt, mar; 1b2) pain, mar (participle)
